digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test suite / stall remote fixture
propositions: Git-fetch test incorrectly classifies valid dribbling transfers as stalled under full-suite scheduler load due to shared 2-second low-speed window between stall controls and integration tests
Delayed scheduler wake-ups reduce fake-server throughput below configured rate, causing cumulative drift that triggers libcurl's no-byte timeout prematurely
Cumulative catch-up calculation alone cannot recover after libcurl aborts during a single uninterrupted scheduling gap that exceeds the configured window
Test fixture must separate zero-byte stall detection (2-second window) from production dribble integration test (10-second window) and make pacing math deterministic
